start.command: command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1 || { curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh >/dev/null 2>&1; } && export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" && (test -d "$HOME/.venv" || uv venv --system-site-packages --seed "$HOME/.venv") && . "$HOME/.venv/bin/activate" && echo "[jl] No dependency file detected, using template packages" && tar -xzf /home/m3_probe_data.tgz -C /home && apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq ffmpeg libsndfile1 || true && python3 probe.py
